verdict.rationale: Brex documents an automatic accounting sync, but only with Puzzle, plus vague claims of one-click accounting setup and real-time close. Nothing in the evidence shows integration with QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero, or user-controlled GL, class, or department mappings. Missing for 10: documented QuickBooks/NetSuite/Xero sync, GL account/class/department mapping controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
